title: The New Covenant Applied: Acts
subtitle: Acts 1-28
theme: The Spirit comes. The church is born. The gospel reaches the ends of the earth.
memoryText: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you, and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the end of the earth.
reviewQuestions: How does Pentecost fulfill the promises of Joel, Ezekiel, and Jeremiah?
What does the Jerusalem Council decide?
How does Paul’s missionary strategy reflect the Abrahamic promise?
What does Acts teach us about the nature of the church?
psalmsNote: Psalms 2, 16, and 110, which Peter preaches from, and mission psalms (67, 87, 117, 96, 98, 100).
